title: KakaoTalk Clone
role: End-to-end planning, UI implementation, publishing, and frontend development
introduction: A Vue 3 SPA implementation of KakaoTalk's primary user flows. Chat, friends, and settings are separated into routes and reusable components, with shared UI and deployment configuration organized for maintainability and feature expansion.
myWorks: Mapped core KakaoTalk screens to Vue Router 4 routes and layout components
Set up Vite 6 with Sass (SCSS) and SVG icons via vite-svg-loader
Integrated @vuepic/vue-datepicker and holiday-kr for date and holiday-aware UI
Aligned local and deployed paths with `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` and dev/root npm scripts for GitHub Pages
achievements: Established a scalable Vue 3 Composition API structure while expanding screens and shared components
Built an end-to-end Vue SPA workflow covering routing, bundling, and deployment
points: Routing and components for chat, friends, and settings
README with local setup and deployment paths
